```{r setup}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(leaflet)
library(ggiraph)
library(crosstalk)
library(RColorBrewer)

cache_file <- "data/geocoded_crashes.rds"

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  evanston_crashes <- read_rds(cache_file)
} else {
  # Read raw Excel file
  crashes_raw <- read_csv("data/Crash audit with citations 061625 - 091526 (1).csv",
                            col_types = "ccccccc")
  
  # Construct search strings for geocoding
  crashes_prepared <- crashes_raw |> 
    filter_out(is.na(`Crash Number`)) |> 
    mutate(
      # Replace terminology
      collision_mode = recode_values(`Collision Type`,
                                     "PEDALCYCLIST" ~ "Bicyclist",
                                     "PEDESTRIAN" ~ "Pedestrian",
                                     default = "Vehicle-Vehicle"),
      
      # Text to titlecase
      `Most Serious Injury` = str_to_title(`Most Serious Injury`),
      
      # Build street address query string for geocoding
      geocode_address = case_when(
        !is.na(`Cross Street Full`) & `Cross Street Full` != "" ~ paste0(`Primary Street Full`, " and ", `Cross Street Full`, ", Evanston, IL"),
        TRUE ~ paste0(`Primary Street Full`, ", Evanston, IL")
      )
    )
  
  # Batch geocode addresses via ArcGIS service
  crashes_geocoded <- crashes_prepared |> 
    geocode(address = geocode_address, method = 'arcgis', lat = latitude, long = longitude) |> 
    filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude))
  
  # Parse datetime, format factors, and convert to sf object
  evanston_crashes <- crashes_geocoded |> 
    mutate(
      crash_datetime = mdy_hm(`Date and Time`),
      year = year(crash_datetime),
      Most_Serious_Injury = factor(
        `Most Serious Injury`, 
        levels = c(
          "No Apparent Injury",
          "Possible Injury",
          "Suspected Minor Injury",
          "Suspected Serious Injury",
          "Fatal Injury"   
        )
      )
    ) |> 
    st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
  
  # Cache geocoded dataset locally
  write_rds(evanston_crashes, cache_file)
}

```

### Notes on the data:

- These are crashes that the police wrote a report for and this dataset is certainly not a complete picture of crashes in Evanston.
- "Suspected Serious Injury" means something like life-threatening, "Suspected Minor Injury" is for anything not immediately life threatening (including a broken rib or femur).

## Map

Use the controls on the left to filter the crash markers by year, injury severity, and vulnerable user. 

```{r map}
# Create SharedData object for Crosstalk filtering
shared_crashes <- SharedData$new(evanston_crashes)

# Define color palette matching the original YlOrRd scheme
# Define explicit color mapping
injury_colors <- c(
  "No Apparent Injury"       = "#999999",
  "Possible Injury"          = "#FECC5C",
  "Suspected Minor Injury"   = "#FD8D3C",
  "Suspected Serious Injury" = "#E31A1C",
  "Fatal Injury"                 = "#800026"
)

pal <- colorFactor(palette = injury_colors, domain = evanston_crashes$Most_Serious_Injury)

# Layout filters and map side-by-side
bscols(
  widths = c(3, 9),
  list(
    filter_checkbox("year", "Year", shared_crashes, ~year),
    filter_checkbox("injury", "Injury Severity", shared_crashes, ~Most_Serious_Injury, allLevels = TRUE),
    filter_checkbox("type", "Road user type", shared_crashes, ~collision_mode)
  ),
  leaflet(shared_crashes, width = "100%", height = 550) |> 
    addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |>
    #addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmooth) |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      radius = 6,
      fillColor = ~pal(Most_Serious_Injury),
      fillOpacity = 0.85,
      color = "#444444",
      weight = 1,
      popup = ~paste0(
        "<strong>Location:</strong> ", geocode_address, "<br/>",
        "<strong>Vulnerable Road User:</strong> ", collision_mode, "<br/>",
        "<strong>Severity:</strong> ", Most_Serious_Injury, "<br/>",
        "<strong>Date:</strong> ", format(crash_datetime, "%B %d, %Y %I:%M %p")
      )
    ) |> 
    addLegend(
      pal = pal,
      values = evanston_crashes$Most_Serious_Injury,
      title = "Injury Severity",
      position = "bottomright"
    )
)
```

## Crash Trends over Time

```{r barGraph}
# Aggregate crash counts by year, month, collision type, and injury severity
crashes_summary <- evanston_crashes |> 
  filter(collision_mode != "Vehicle-Vehicle") |>
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  mutate(
    # Derive an ordered month factor (Jan–Dec) from the crash date
    month = month(crash_datetime, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  group_by(year, month, collision_mode, Most_Serious_Injury) |> 
  summarise(total = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Build ggplot graph with interactive geom
p <- ggplot(
  data = crashes_summary, 
  aes(
    x = month, 
    y = total, 
    fill = Most_Serious_Injury
  )
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>Month:</b> ", month, " ", year, "<br>",
        "<b>Collision Type:</b> ", collision_mode, "<br>",
        "<b>Injury Severity:</b> ", Most_Serious_Injury, "<br>",
        "<b>Crashes:</b> ", total
      ),
      data_id = Most_Serious_Injury
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = injury_colors, name = "Injury Severity") +
  # Keep all 12 months on the axis, even for partial years
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(collision_mode ~ year) +
  labs(
    title = "Evanston Crashes Involving Pedestrians & Bicyclists",
    subtitle = "June 2025 – Sept 2026",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Crashes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

# Render interactive ggiraph plot
girafe(
  ggobj = p,
  options = list(
    opts_hover(css = "opacity:0.8;cursor:pointer;"),
    opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.3;"),
    opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
  )
)
```

```{js}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  setTimeout(function() {
    // 1. Check ALL Year checkboxes
    document.querySelectorAll('#year input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(cb) {
      cb.checked = true;
      cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    });

    // 2. Check ALL Collision Type checkboxes (Bicycle & Pedestrian)
    document.querySelectorAll('#type input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(cb) {
      cb.checked = true;
      cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    });
    
    // 3. Check selected Injury Severities
    const targetInjuries = [
     "Suspected Minor Injury",
     "Suspected Serious Injury",
     "Fatal Injury"   
    ];
    document.querySelectorAll('#injury input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(cb) {
    if (targetInjuries.includes(cb.value)) {
    cb.checked = true;
        cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
      }
    });
  }, 300);
});
```
